name: Arc Browser
tagline: Arc is a browser by The Browser Company that rethinks how people interact with the web, built with AI as a first-class feature. Arc Search on iOS uses AI to synthesise multiple search results into a single browseable summary rather than a list of links. On desktop, Arc Max features include Ask on Page (ask questions about the page you are reading), 5-second previews, and AI-generated tab titles and folder names. Arc has become the browser of choice for many tech workers and developers looking for a more intelligent daily browsing experience.
